crew.overview: Less than 24 hours into his parole, charismatic thief Danny Ocean is already rolling out his next plan: In one night, Danny's hand-picked crew of specialists will attempt to steal more than $150 million from three Las Vegas casinos. But to score the cash, Danny risks his chances of reconciling with ex-wife, Tess.
crew.title: Ocean's Eleven

details.biography: Frankie Pine, who works under the banner Whirly Girl Music, is an Emmy & Grammy nominated Music Supervisor creating memorable, provocative, and engaging soundtracks for high-profile film and television projects. Frankie has received a total of 11 Guild of Music Supervisors Awards nominations, winning Best Music Supervisor in 2013 for her work on Magic Mike; two additional wins in 2014 and 2015 for Nashville; and a fourth GMS win for Sylvie’s Love in 2021.
details.name: Frankie Pine
